steps.title: Create the engine
steps.note: createWorkflowEngine initializes the workflow registry, execution registry, node-type registry, and active-execution tracking. Configurable limits include max concurrent executions and default timeout.

steps.title: Register built-in node types
steps.note: Built-in node types cover triggers (manual, schedule, webhook), transforms (map, filter), conditions (if), loops (for-each), delays, HTTP requests, and outputs. Each declares input/output ports and an executor.

steps.title: Execute a workflow
steps.note: execute() builds the DAG, seeds the execution context, and starts every node that has no incoming connections. Completed output nodes are collected into execution.outputs.

steps.title: Execute a single node
steps.note: executeNode() waits until all dependency nodes have results, runs the node executor, stores the result in execution.context.state.nodeResults, and recursively executes downstream nodes that pass any connection condition.
